headline: Fort Hays State complete an unbeaten conference season
dek: Fort Hays State won eleven and drew one of their twelve conference matches for 34 points, the draw at Rogers State the only points they dropped. Rogers State and Northeastern State finished level on 19 points, fifteen behind them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State's 32 goals are more than Harding and Newman have managed between them.

wire.line: Northeastern State beat Rogers State, the side level with them on points, and face Fort Hays State next.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's home match against UT Dallas is past its date with no result published, the only such match in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fort Hays State have conceded nine goals this season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Harding have drawn one and lost seventeen, and have yet to win a match this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Guilherme Borges has kept four shutouts for Newman.

last_match.line: Northeastern State have now beaten Rogers State home and away.

next_match.line: Northeastern State are yet to take a point from Fort Hays State.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
